artifacts.summary: Seed: pr_watch.py keeps one machine-local state file for every session, and check/wait mark changes as seen, so concurrent FO sessions consume each other's changes (this FO consumed relay#368's checks pending -> green on 2026-10-14; the relay FO reported #642/#643 in its default state). The merged fo-lifecycle-mod (#643) makes every adopter FO run pr_watch.py tasks and wait at startup and idle with the default state, so syncing it to qnow, relay and ss-web on one machine would multiply the loss. Seed check: design_surfaces.py check --seed exit 0. Recommended profile pilot. Ideation owes the per-session or per-workflow state key, migration of existing entries, and a test with two callers that each still see a change.
